desc_zh: 已验证的非营利组织购买 Microsoft 365 Copilot 可少 15%，年付为 25.50 美元/人/月。必须另外已有符合条件的 Microsoft 365 许可证。订阅里包含的 Copilot Chat 不另收费。美国页面还写 Business Premium 员工价为年付 5.50 美元/人/月，约为商业价的 25%。
desc_en: Verified nonprofits can save 15% on Microsoft 365 Copilot, at $25.50 per user per month when paid annually. An eligible Microsoft 365 license must already be in place. Copilot Chat included in the subscription is free. The US page also states that the Business Premium employee price is $5.50 per user per month when paid annually, which is about 25% of the commercial price.
claim_zh:
1. 先确认组织已通过微软非营利验证，并且已有 Microsoft 365 许可证。
2. 管理员点击本页的「前往官网领取」，在管理中心按非营利价格购买 Copilot。
3. 付款前核对人数和年付总价。Copilot Chat 已包含在 Microsoft 365 里，不必为聊天单独买 Copilot。
claim_en:
1. First, confirm that your organization has passed Microsoft's nonprofit verification and already has a Microsoft 365 license.
2. Administrators should click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page and purchase Copilot at the nonprofit price in the admin center.
3. Before payment, verify the number of users and the total annual cost. Copilot Chat is already included in Microsoft 365, so there's no need to purchase Copilot separately for chat.

name_zh: Rosalind Academic Plan 实验室免费席位
name_en: Rosalind Academic Plan Free Seats for Labs
desc_zh: 面向美国大学的学术实验室。由 PI 或实验室负责人申请，审核通过后最多 30 个 ChatGPT Business Standard 席位可免费使用 12 个月，并在可信访问批准后使用生命科学模型 GPT-Rosalind。工作区里也能用 ChatGPT 和 Codex，不含 API。研究数据默认不用于训练，但没有零数据保留。这和 ChatGPT for Academic Researchers 不是同一个计划。
desc_en: For academic labs at U.S. universities. Applications are submitted by the PI or lab director. Upon approval, up to 30 ChatGPT Business Standard seats can be used free of charge for 12 months, and the life sciences model GPT-Rosalind can be used after trusted access is approved. ChatGPT and Codex are also available in the workspace, but the API is not included. Research data is not used for training by default, but there is no zero-data retention policy. This is not the same program as ChatGPT for Academic Researchers.
claim_zh:
1. 确认实验室在美国的大学，并且学校允许单独开通 ChatGPT Business 工作区。学校已经签了 OpenAI Enterprise 协议的，改为联系学校管理员，走 Enterprise 申请。
2. 由 PI 或实验室负责人用绑定学校.edu 邮箱的 ChatGPT 账号，在公告页提交学术实验室申请。填写学校、实验室、职务和预期用途，并完成身份核验。
3. 准备一位学校指定的生物安全联系人，例如环境健康与安全、研究安全或生物安全官员。
4. 批准后按邮件完成工作区设置。开通时需要绑定付款卡。再把使用同一学校邮箱域名的成员加进来，并单独打开他们的 GPT-Rosalind 权限。
5. 免费期最长 12 个月，一个工作区最多 30 席。实验室成员不能单独申请。到期后的价格以获批时的协议为准。
claim_en:
1. Confirm that the lab is at a U.S. university and that the institution allows separate activation of a ChatGPT Business workspace. If the institution has already signed an OpenAI Enterprise agreement, contact the school administrator instead and proceed with the Enterprise application process.
2. The PI or lab director must submit the academic lab application on the announcement page using a ChatGPT account linked to a school.edu email address. Provide the school, lab, role, and intended use, and complete identity verification.
3. Prepare a biosecurity contact designated by the school, such as an environmental health and safety officer, research safety officer, or biosecurity officer.
4. After approval, complete workspace setup via email. A payment card must be linked during activation. Then add members using the same school email domain and separately enable their GPT-Rosalind permissions.
5. The free period lasts up to 12 months, with a maximum of 30 seats per workspace. Lab members cannot apply individually. Pricing after the free period will follow the agreement in effect at the time of approval.

desc_zh: iAsk 是带问答的 AI 搜索。学生完成身份验证后，可免费使用 Pro 一年。
desc_en: iAsk is an AI-powered search with Q&A. Students can use the Pro version for free for one year after completing identity verification.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，注册或登录 iAsk。
2. 按页面完成学生验证。通过后 Pro 免费一年，以账户里显示的到期日为准。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page to register or log in to iAsk.
2. Complete the student verification on the page. Once approved, you'll receive one year of free Pro access, as indicated by the expiration date shown in your account.

name_zh: ChatGPT Plus 退伍军人免费一年
name_en: ChatGPT Plus Free for One Year for Veterans
desc_zh: 面向美国军人：过去 12 个月内从现役退伍或退休的人，以及未来 12 个月内即将离开现役的军人。用 ID.me 验证后，可在个人 ChatGPT 账号上免费使用一年 ChatGPT Plus。Plus 包含 GPT-6：聊天里可用 GPT-6 Sol 的中档和高档思考，ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 里包含 GPT-6 Astra，另外还有更高的消息和上传额度、深度研究、图像生成、项目和自定义 GPT。每人限领一次，不能转赠，也不能和其他优惠叠加。企业工作区账号不能领。通过 App Store 或 Google Play 订阅的 Plus，要等移动端订阅结束后才能领。免费年结束后按原价续费，除非提前取消。
desc_en: For U.S. military personnel: Individuals who have been discharged from active duty or retired within the past 12 months, as well as those who will leave active duty within the next 12 months. After verification via ID.me, you can use ChatGPT Plus for free for one year on your personal ChatGPT account. Plus includes GPT-6: mid-tier and high-tier thinking capabilities with GPT-6 Sol in chat, GPT-6 Astra in ChatGPT Work and Codex, as well as higher message and upload limits, in-depth research, image generation, projects, and custom GPTs. This offer is limited to one claim per person, cannot be transferred, and cannot be combined with other promotions. Enterprise workspace accounts are not eligible. For Plus subscriptions purchased through the App Store or Google Play, you must wait until your mobile subscription ends before claiming the offer. After the free year ends, your subscription will renew at the regular price unless canceled in advance.
claim_zh:
1. 用要领取优惠的个人 ChatGPT 账号登录，打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 选择 Verify with ID.me，完成军人身份验证，并允许把结果发给 OpenAI。如果没有返回退役日期，就按提示补上。
3. 页面显示资格确认后，点 Claim offer。已经在网页版订阅 Plus 的不要先取消，验证后会直接记上一整年。
4. 如果 Plus 是在 App Store 或 Google Play 买的，先在对应商店取消，等订阅结束后再回来领取。
claim_en:
1. Log in with the personal ChatGPT account you want to use for the offer and open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Select Verify with ID.me, complete the military identity verification, and allow the results to be sent to OpenAI. If your discharge date is not returned, follow the prompts to provide it.
3. Once your eligibility is confirmed on the page, click Claim offer. If you are already subscribed to Plus via the web version, do not cancel first; your subscription will be extended by a full year after verification.
4. If your Plus subscription was purchased through the App Store or Google Play, cancel it first in the respective store, then return to claim the offer after your subscription has ended.

name_zh: 阿里云 QoderWork CN 高校专属权益
name_en: Alibaba Cloud QoderWork CN Student & Teacher Benefits
desc_zh: QoderWork CN 是阿里云推出的桌面级 AI 智能体助手，支持通过对话完成 PPT 编写美化、论文排版查重、数据分析与可视化、代码生成与调试等学习任务。高校专属权益面向在校大学生与教师：通过身份核验后，在享受新用户首月免费 Pro（价值 59 元）的基础上，可额外获得 4,000 Credits（有效期 90 天）。学生通过支付宝连接学信网学籍信息完成实时核验；教师提交身份证明后 1-3 个工作日审核，权益在审核通过后 T+1 工作日自动发放。同一身份仅可绑定 1 个阿里云账号、领取 1 次权益。
desc_en: QoderWork CN is Alibaba Cloud's desktop AI agent assistant for completing study tasks via conversation: PPT creation, paper editing, data analysis & visualization, and code generation. University students and teachers who pass identity verification receive a free first-month Pro membership (worth CNY 59) plus 4,000 additional Credits (valid 90 days). Students verify instantly via Alipay + Xuexin.com; teachers submit credentials for 1-3 business day review, with benefits issued T+1 day post-approval. Each identity may bind to only one Alibaba Cloud account and claim benefits once.
claim_zh:
步骤一：下载 QoderWork CN 客户端并使用阿里云账号登录，领取新用户首月免费 Pro 权益。
步骤二：返回认证页面本页的「前往官网领取」，使用同一阿里云账号登录。
步骤三（学生）：点击【学生认证 -> 立即领取】，按提示通过支付宝查询学信网学籍信息完成实时核验，核验成功后即可领取 4,000 Credits。
步骤三（教师）：点击【教师认证】，上传教师身份证明材料，等待 1-3 个工作日审核，审核通过后 T+1 工作日自动发放权益。
注意：同一身份只能绑定 1 个阿里云账号，仅可领取 1 次。近一个月内已完成认证的用户可直接领取，无需二次认证。
claim_en:
Step 1: Download the QoderWork CN client and log in with an Alibaba Cloud account to claim the new user first-month free Pro benefit.
Step 2: Return to the verification page the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and log in with the same Alibaba Cloud account.
Step 3 (Students): Click [Student Verification -> Claim Now], follow the prompts to query CHSI student status information via Alipay for real-time verification, and after successful verification, claim 4,000 Credits.
Step 3 (Teachers): Click [Teacher Verification], upload teacher identity proof materials, wait 1-3 working days for review, and benefits will be automatically issued on T+1 working day after approval.
Note: The same identity can only be bound to 1 Alibaba Cloud account and can only be claimed 1 time. Users who have completed verification within the past month can claim directly without a second verification.

name_zh: YC AI Stack 学生福利
desc_zh: 参加 YC 高校活动后，可领取价值超过 $25,000 的学生免费额度：AWS、Azure 各 $10,000，OpenAI $1,000，Anthropic $500，以及多家 YC 公司的 AI 开发工具。资格自活动日起一年。
desc_en: After a YC university event, students can redeem over $25,000 in free credits: $10,000 AWS, $10,000 Azure, $1,000 OpenAI, $500 Anthropic, plus AI tools from YC companies. Access lasts one year from the qualifying event.
claim_zh:
1. 参加 YC 高校活动（官方写 Fall 2025 起）。
2. 活动后查收确认邮件。
3. 用报名时的 Hacker News 账号登录本页的「前往官网领取」，资格会自动识别。
4. 逐项兑换云与 AI 额度。权益从活动日起一年。问题可写 deals@ycombinator.com。
claim_en:
1. Attend a YC university event (officially listed as starting Fall 2025).
2. After the event, check for a confirmation email.
3. Log in at the "Get it on the official site" button on this page with the Hacker News account you used to sign up; eligibility is recognized automatically.
4. Redeem the cloud and AI credits one by one. Benefits last one year from the event date. Questions can be sent to deals@ycombinator.com.

name_zh: Claude Pro 高校优惠（已结束）
desc_zh: 斯坦福、华盛顿大学、康奈尔和卡内基梅隆曾经提供 Claude Pro 约 $1/月。该限时校内优惠已结束。
desc_en: Stanford, University of Washington, Cornell, and Carnegie Mellon once offered Claude Pro for approximately $1/month. This limited-time university discount has ended.
claim_zh: 这个优惠已经结束，不会再按每月 $1 开通。现在的价格以 Claude 官网结算页为准。
claim_en: This discount has ended and will no longer be available at $1 per month. The current price is subject to the settlement page on the official Claude website.

desc_zh: 501(c)(3) 及其对应的境外慈善组织、社会企业，可申请 Twilio 的短信、语音等产品折扣，并获得不会过期的免费用量，官方说足够发出数千条短信和通话。不要求签月度合约。超过 1200 万个组织可通过 Goodstack 快速审核。具体额度和折扣以批准信为准。
desc_en: 501(c)(3) organizations and their corresponding foreign charities and social enterprises can apply for discounts on Twilio's SMS, voice, and other products, as well as receive free usage that never expires—officially stated to be enough to send thousands of SMS messages and make calls. No monthly contract is required. Over 12 million organizations can undergo a fast-track review through Goodstack. Specific quotas and discounts are subject to the approval letter.
claim_zh:
1. 组织联系人点击本页的「前往官网领取」，按资格说明提交申请。
2. 一般 2 到 5 个工作日收到结果。通过后免费用量不会过期。
3. 先用免费额度做第一条短信或通话，再按折扣价扩大用量。
claim_en:
1. The organization's contact person should click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page and submit an application according to the eligibility criteria.
2. Results are typically received within 2 to 5 business days. Once approved, the free usage will not expire.
3. First, use the free quota for your initial SMS or call, then expand your usage at the discounted rate.

name_zh: Lovable Pro 瑞典学生免费到年底
name_en: Lovable Pro Free for Swedish Students Until the End of the Year
desc_zh: 在瑞典的大学、学院或国民高等学校就读、年满 18 岁的学生，用学校邮箱可以免费使用 Lovable Pro，从 2026 年 9 月 1 日到 12 月 31 日，含每月 100 积分。每人限一个工作区，不能和其他 Lovable 优惠叠加，也不含另外购买的积分。2027 年 1 月 1 日起自动改为学生五折。已经绑定付款方式的会开始扣费，不想继续要提前取消；没有付款方式的不会扣费。
desc_en: Students aged 18 or older enrolled in a Swedish university, college, or national upper secondary school can use Lovable Pro for free with their school email address from September 1, 2026, to December 31, 2026, including 100 credits per month. Each person is limited to one workspace, and this offer cannot be combined with other Lovable discounts or additional purchased credits. Starting January 1, 2027, the offer will automatically switch to a 50% student discount. Users who have already linked a payment method will begin to be charged; if you no longer wish to continue, you must cancel in advance. Users without a linked payment method will not be charged.
claim_zh:
1. 打开活动页。还没有账号的，先用瑞典学校发放、目前仍可使用的邮箱注册。Lovable 账号邮箱必须是这个学校邮箱。
2. 在页面上验证并领取免费 Pro。2026 年 9 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日之间随时可以领。9 月 1 日之后领取的，从领取当天算到 12 月 31 日。
3. 工作区如果已经在付费的 Pro 1，已付的周期不退款。免费从当前付费周期结束时开始，最晚到 12 月 31 日。
4. 免费期结束后会自动套上学生五折。已绑定付款方式的，2027 年 1 月 1 日起按五折扣费，不想续费要在此之前取消。
claim_en:
1. Open the promotion page. If you don't have an account yet, first register using a school email address issued by a Swedish institution that is still valid. Your Lovable account must use this school email address.
2. Verify your email on the page and claim your free Pro subscription. You can claim it at any time between September 1 and December 31, 2026. If you claim it after September 1, the free period will start on the day of claiming and end on December 31.
3. If your workspace is already on the paid Pro 1 plan, the period you've already paid for will not be refunded. The free period will begin at the end of your current paid cycle, but no later than December 31.
4. After the free period ends, the 50% student discount will be automatically applied. For users who have linked a payment method, charges will be applied at a 50% discount starting January 1, 2027. If you do not want to renew, you must cancel before this date.

name_zh: Termius 学生免费 Pro 和 Team
name_en: Termius Free Pro and Team for Students
desc_zh: SSH 客户端。持有已激活 GitHub Student Developer Pack 的学生，可免费使用 Termius Pro 和 Team 的全部功能，包括在多台设备间同步，以及和同学共享主机与会话。GitHub 状态必须是 Activated，只显示 Approved 还不行。状态刚变更时，同步到 Termius 最多可能要等 72 小时。
desc_en: SSH client. Students with an activated GitHub Student Developer Pack can use all features of Termius Pro and Team for free, including synchronization across multiple devices and sharing hosts and sessions with classmates. Your GitHub status must be Activated; Approved alone is not sufficient. When the status has just changed, it may take up to 72 hours for it to sync with Termius.
claim_zh:
1. 打开 GitHub Student Developer Pack 面板，确认状态是 Activated，而不是刚通过审核的 Approved。
2. 打开 Termius 教育页，用同一个 GitHub 账号绑定。
3. 如果刚刚激活，等最多 72 小时再试。
claim_en:
1. Open the GitHub Student Developer Pack dashboard and confirm that your status is Activated, not just Approved after review.
2. Open the Termius education page and link it using the same GitHub account.
3. If you've just activated your account, wait up to 72 hours before trying again.

name_zh: Working Copy 学生免费 Pro
name_en: Working Copy Pro Free for Students
desc_zh: iPhone 和 iPad 上的全功能 Git 客户端。用 GitHub 学生开发者包账号登录即可免费解锁 Pro 功能（原价 $35.99），可以克隆、编辑、提交、推送和发起 Pull Request。
desc_en: Full-featured Git client for iPhone and iPad. Sign in with your GitHub Student Developer Pack account to unlock Pro features (normally $35.99) for free: clone, edit, commit, push and open pull requests.
claim_zh:
1. 先通过 GitHub Education 认证，获得 GitHub 学生开发者包
2. 在 App Store 安装或更新 Working Copy（iPhone / iPad）
3. 在设备上打开本页的「前往官网领取」，点击页面上的验证链接
4. 用学生 GitHub 账号登录，即可免费使用全部 Pro 功能
claim_en:
1. First get verified through GitHub Education to get the GitHub Student Developer Pack
2. Install or update Working Copy from the App Store (iPhone / iPad)
3. On your device, open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and tap the verification link on the page
4. Sign in with your student GitHub account to use all Pro features for free

name_zh: Qt 教育许可 学生和教师免费 12 个月
name_en: Qt Education License: Free for Students and Teachers for 12 Months
desc_zh: 有高等教育机构邮箱的在读学生和教师，可免费领取 12 个月 Qt 教育许可，只用于学习，不能商用。可以两套都领：设计版包含 Qt Design Studio Enterprise，可从 Figma、Sketch、Adobe XD 导入界面；开发版包含 Qt Device Creation Professional，支持 Python、C++、JavaScript、HTML5 和 QML，可部署到树莓派以及部分 ST、NXP、瑞萨 MCU，并附带 Design Studio Professional。没有官方技术支持，可以看 Qt Academy 和论坛。做出的应用只能为了学习分享。到期后可以申请续期。
desc_en: Current students and teachers with an email address from a higher education institution can receive a free 12-month Qt Education License for learning purposes only, not for commercial use. Both editions are available: the Design Edition includes Qt Design Studio Enterprise, allowing you to import interfaces from Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD; the Development Edition includes Qt Device Creation Professional, supporting Python, C++, JavaScript, HTML5, and QML, with deployment capabilities to Raspberry Pi and select ST, NXP, and Renesas MCUs, along with Design Studio Professional. Official technical support is not provided, but resources such as Qt Academy and forums are available. Applications created must be shared solely for educational purposes. Renewal can be requested after the license expires.
claim_zh:
1. 打开申请页，用高等教育机构邮箱填表，并设置 Qt 账号密码。系统会自动核对邮箱是否属于已知院校。
2. 查收验证邮件并点击链接，垃圾箱也要看。
3. 按邮件说明安装。许可 12 个月，需要继续用时再申请续期。
claim_en:
1. Open the application page, fill out the form using your higher education institution's email address, and set up your Qt account and password. The system will automatically verify whether your email belongs to a recognized institution.
2. Check your inbox for the verification email and click the link. Also, check your spam folder.
3. Follow the instructions in the email to complete the installation. The license is valid for 12 months; you'll need to apply for renewal if you wish to continue using it.

name_zh: Unity 学生计划（免费 Unity Pro）
desc_zh: 年满 16 岁、在认证学校在读的学生可免费领取 Unity Student：最新 Unity Pro 编辑器、Odin Inspector/Validator 教育许可、Synty 资源包和 Unity Cloud。通过 SheerID 验证，许可一年，在读可续期。
desc_en: Students 16+ at an accredited school can get Unity Student free: the latest Unity Pro Editor, an Odin Inspector and Validator education license, a Synty asset bundle, and Unity Cloud. Verify with SheerID. The license lasts one year and can be renewed while enrolled.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，按学段选择 Post-Secondary 或 Secondary。
2. 注册或登录 Unity ID（不必用学校邮箱）。
3. 用 SheerID 提交学籍信息；多数即时通过，补充材料会发邮件。
4. 查收许可密钥，在 Unity Hub 激活学生许可。
计划一年有效，到期或到期前 60 天可续；仅绑定一个 Unity ID。课堂机房请走学校 Education Grant，不要用学生计划批量装机。
claim_en:
1. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and select Post-Secondary or Secondary based on your education level.
2. Register or sign in with a Unity ID (a school email is not required).
3. Submit your enrollment information through SheerID; most are approved instantly, and requests for additional materials are sent by email.
4. Receive your license key and activate the student license in Unity Hub.
The plan is valid for one year and can be renewed at expiration or up to 60 days before it expires; it is tied to only one Unity ID. For classroom labs, use the school's Education Grant; do not use the student plan for bulk installations.

desc_zh: 通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack 验证的学生，可免费使用一年 Neve Agency（官方写价值 $259），含不限站点、更新和支持。
desc_en: Students verified through the GitHub Student Developer Pack get one year of Neve Agency free (listed as a $259 value), including unlimited sites, updates, and support.
claim_zh:
1. 先完成 GitHub Education 学生验证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录领取。
3. 许可为一年 Agency，不限站点。
claim_en:
1. Complete GitHub Education student verification first.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and sign in with GitHub to claim.
3. The license is one-year Agency, with unlimited sites.

desc_zh: GitHub 学生可免费使用一年 Honeybadger Small：22.5 万错误额度、60 天保留、60 个可用性检查、不限用户和应用。官方写价值超过 $700。
desc_en: GitHub students get Honeybadger Small free for one year: a 225,000 error limit, 60-day retention, 60 uptime checks, and unlimited users and apps. Honeybadger lists it as over a $700 value.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」领取一年 Small 方案。
3. 问题可写 support@honeybadger.io。
claim_en:
1. First join the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to claim the one-year Small plan.
3. For questions, email support@honeybadger.io.

desc_zh: 已验证的高校学生可通过 GitHub Education 免费使用一年 Requestly Professional。官方写价值 $270，只限个人账号，每人一次。
desc_en: Verified post-secondary students can get Requestly Professional free for one year through GitHub Education. Requestly lists it at $270. Individual accounts only, once per person.
claim_zh:
1. 先通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录领取。
3. 已付费用户会把剩余时间折成额度。一年后不再自动续免费，可买订阅或回到免费版。
claim_en:
1. First, get approved for GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and sign in with GitHub to claim.
3. Paid users will have their remaining time converted to credit. After one year, it will not auto-renew for free; you can buy a subscription or return to the free version.

name_zh: AWS Builder Center 学生奖励计划
desc_zh: AWS 学生福利计划：验证学生身份并完善资料，立即解锁12个月Skill Builder高级会员（价值$449），活跃赢徽章还可再得$30积分和$100认证考试券。
desc_en: Verify your student status to unlock 12 months of AWS Skill Builder Premium free ($449 value), plus earn AWS credits and a $100 certification exam voucher through activity badges.
claim_zh:
1. 访问 builder.aws.com 并登录/注册 AWS Builder Center 账号（可用现有 AWS 账号登录）。
2. 在个人资料页找到 Student Status（学生状态）入口，点击进行 SheerID 学生身份验证，通常几分钟内完成（需年满 18 岁、在认可高校在读）。
3. 验证通过后，完善 Builder Center 个人资料：上传头像并填写 About 简介，完成后立即解锁 12 个月 AWS Skill Builder 高级会员（价值 $449）。
4. 在 Builder Center 保持活跃赢取徽章：发表文章、评论、参与 Wishlist 等操作可累积徽章。
5. 达到 7 个徽章解锁 $10 云积分；14 个徽章再得 $20；21 个徽章兑换 $100 的 AWS Foundational 认证考试代金券。
注意：该计划为 2026 返校季限时推出，具体权益与有效期以官方页面为准。
claim_en:
1. Visit builder.aws.com and log in/register for an AWS Builder Center account (you can use your existing AWS account to log in).
2. On your profile page, find the Student Status entry, click to verify your student status via SheerID, which usually takes a few minutes (you must be at least 18 years old and enrolled at an accredited college or university).
3. After verification, complete your Builder Center profile: upload a profile picture and fill in the About section. Once done, you will immediately unlock 12 months of AWS Skill Builder Premium membership (worth $449).
4. Stay active in Builder Center to earn badges: publishing articles, commenting, participating in Wishlist, and other activities can accumulate badges.
5. Reach 7 badges to unlock $10 in cloud credits; 14 badges to get another $20; 21 badges to redeem a $100 AWS Foundational certification exam voucher.
Note: This program is a limited-time offer for the 2026 back-to-school season. Specific benefits and expiration dates are subject to the official page.

desc_zh: NVIDIA 和高校研究者合作，给授予博士学位的高校全职教师提供云端 GPU 时长、硬件或软件，以及 NVIDIA 模型。方向包括仿真建模、生成式训练、推理与智能体，资源可以到 3 万小时 H100，或若干 RTX PRO / DGX Spark。提案必须使用 NVIDIA 预训练模型或软件栈，并按当轮征集说明和模板来写。全球可交，竞争性录取，不是本科生个人优惠。官方目前不接受新申请。
desc_en: NVIDIA collaborates with university researchers to provide cloud GPU time, hardware, software, and NVIDIA models to full-time faculty members at universities that award doctoral degrees. Focus areas include simulation and modeling, generative training, inference, and agents. Resources can include up to 30,000 hours of H100 time or several RTX PRO / DGX Spark units. Proposals must utilize NVIDIA's pre-trained models or software stack and be written according to the guidelines and template for the current call. Applications are open globally, with competitive selection; this is not a personal benefit for undergraduate students. Officially, new applications are currently not being accepted.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，先看当轮是否开放以及对应的征集说明。
2. 须是授予博士学位高校的全职教师。按提案模板提交，不符合模板的不审。
3. 获批后按批准的云端时长或硬件使用。上轮获奖者要先交结果，才能再申请。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Apply" on this page to check if the current call is open and review the corresponding guidelines.
2. Applicants must be full-time faculty members at universities that award doctoral degrees. Submissions must follow the proposal template; applications that do not comply will not be reviewed.
3. Upon approval, use the approved cloud time or hardware as specified. Previous round winners must first submit their results before applying again.

desc_zh: Goodnotes 教育版在普通笔记之外，包含手写拼写检查、数学转换、数学助手、无限文件夹和手写搜索，并可以同步到 iCloud、Google Drive、OneDrive、Dropbox 或 WebDAV。
desc_en: In addition to regular note-taking features, Goodnotes Education Edition includes handwriting spell check, math conversion, a math assistant, unlimited folders, and handwriting search. It also supports synchronization with iCloud, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, or WebDAV.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用学校邮箱申请教育版。
2. 通过后再安装或登录 App。教育功能绑在通过验证的账号上。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and use your school email to apply for the Education Edition.
2. After approval, install or log in to the app. The educational features are linked to the verified account.

desc_zh: Speechify 是文本转语音与语音 AI 助手，可朗读 PDF、网页和课本，支持 200+ 人声、可调倍速和 AI 摘要。教育版面向学校与学生；验证学生通常可通过 UNiDAYS / Student Beans 获 Premium 约 25% 折扣，美国 K-12 可申请免费 Premium。
desc_en: Speechify is a text-to-speech and voice AI assistant that can read PDFs, web pages, and textbooks, with 200+ voices, adjustable speed, and AI summaries. The education offering is for schools and students; verified students typically get about 25% off Premium via UNiDAYS or Student Beans, and US K-12 students may qualify for free Premium.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」了解教育版，或先下载 iOS / Android / 网页 / Chrome 插件试用免费版。
2. 大学生：通过 UNiDAYS 或 Student Beans 完成学生认证后领取 Premium 约 25% 折扣（不是结账输入优惠码）。
3. 美国 K-12 学生可按教育计划申请免费 Premium。
4. 学校或学区批量采购请通过教育页申请演示/联系销售。价格以官方页面为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to learn about the education edition, or first download the iOS / Android / web / Chrome extension to try the free version.
2. University students: complete student verification via UNiDAYS or Student Beans to get about 25% off Premium (not by entering a promo code at checkout).
3. US K-12 students can apply for free Premium through the education program.
4. Schools or districts buying in bulk should request a demo/contact sales via the education page. Prices are subject to the official page.

name_en: ElevenReader Free for Students for One Year
desc_zh: 已验证的学生可以免费使用一年 ElevenReader（价值 $99），把教材、PDF、论文、讲义和网页转成自然语音，不限次数。有跟读高亮，适合 ADHD、阅读障碍或长时间听读，1000 多种音色，iOS、Android 和网页都能听。要年满 18 岁、在读、学校在官方名单里，ElevenLabs 账号邮箱必须和学校发的邮箱一致。一年到期会按常规年费自动续订，要提前在账号账单里取消。已经在付费的不退款，等当前周期结束后再领。学校不在名单里，页面上可以申请加入。
desc_en: Verified students can use ElevenReader for free for one year (worth $99), converting textbooks, PDFs, papers, lecture notes, and web pages into natural speech with no usage limits. Features include read-along highlighting, making it ideal for individuals with ADHD, dyslexia, or those who struggle with prolonged reading. With over 1,000 voice options, it's available on iOS, Android, and web. Users must be at least 18 years old, currently enrolled in a school listed on the official list, and their ElevenLabs account email must match their school-issued email. After the one-year period, the subscription will automatically renew at the standard annual rate; to avoid this, cancel it in advance within your account's billing settings. No refunds are provided for existing paid subscriptions—redeem the offer after the current billing cycle ends. If your school isn't on the list, you can apply to be added on the page.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用学校发的邮箱注册或登录。账号邮箱必须和学校邮箱相同。
2. 完成学校邮箱验证。通过后解锁一年会员，上传 PDF、讲义或网页即可听。
3. 一年结束前如果不要续费，到账号的 Manage Billing 取消。已经在付费的，先取消现有订阅，等周期结束后再按同样步骤领取。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and register or log in using your school-issued email. Your account email must match your school email.
2. Complete the verification using your school email. Once verified, a one-year membership will be unlocked. You can then upload PDFs, lecture notes, or web pages to listen.
3. If you don't want to renew before the year ends, cancel the subscription in your account's Manage Billing section. If you're already paying, first cancel your current subscription, then follow the same steps to claim the offer after the current billing cycle ends.

desc_zh: 师生可免费使用 Excalidraw 白板。用教育邮箱注册后，Excalidraw+ 有教育价（法文官方页写明约 $4/月或 $36/年），以结账页为准。
desc_en: Students and teachers can use the Excalidraw whiteboard for free. An educational email unlocks reduced Excalidraw+ pricing (the French official page lists about $4/month or $36/year). Confirm the amount at checkout.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 免费白板可直接使用。
3. 需要 Plus（云端收藏、语音、PDF/PPTX 导出等）时，用教育邮箱注册并继续到结账，或完成身份核验后再看教育价。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. The free whiteboard can be used directly.
3. If you need Plus (cloud favorites, voice, PDF/PPTX export, etc.), sign up with an education email and continue to checkout, or complete identity verification to see the education price.

desc_zh: 高校写作项目（含电影学院）在读学生可免费使用 Highland 2 完整版一年。用学校邮箱和学生证申请，通过后在 Mac 版里解锁。
desc_en: Students in university writing programs, including film schools, can use the full Highland 2 free for one year. Apply with a school email and student ID, then unlock it in the Mac app.
claim_zh:
1. 在本页的「前往官网领取」提交姓名、.edu 邮箱、项目和学生证。
2. 审核邮件通过后，从 Mac App Store 下载 Highland 2。
3. 菜单里选 Upgrade to Pro，再用同一学校邮箱升级到学生版。一年后打印会带水印，除非付费升级。教师可写 support@quoteunquoteapps.com。
claim_en:
1. Submit your name, .edu email, program, and student ID at the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. After approval by email, download Highland 2 from the Mac App Store.
3. Select Upgrade to Pro from the menu, then upgrade to the student edition using the same school email. After one year, printouts will have a watermark unless you pay for an upgrade. Teachers can email support@quoteunquoteapps.com.

desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可免费使用 Icons8 3 个月，含图标、照片、插画和音乐。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members get a free 3-month Icons8 subscription covering icons, photos, illustrations, and music.
claim_zh:
1. 先通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」领取 3 个月订阅。
3. 时长以 GitHub Education 合作页为准。
claim_en:
1. First get approved for the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to claim the 3-month subscription.
3. Duration is subject to the GitHub Education partner page.

name_zh: Educative GitHub 学生 6 个月
desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可免费使用 Educative 6 个月，在浏览器里做互动课程，无需信用卡。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members get 6 months of Educative free, with in-browser interactive courses. No credit card is required.
claim_zh:
1. 用学校邮箱的 GitHub 账号通过 Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，在同一浏览器登录 Educative 和 GitHub 后领取。
3. 课程在 My Courses 里。审核可能从 1 小时到数周。
claim_en:
1. Use a GitHub account with your school email to qualify for the Student Developer Pack.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and claim it after logging into both Educative and GitHub in the same browser.
3. Courses are in My Courses. Review can take from 1 hour to several weeks.
